subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale, where you can enjoy up to 50% off on selected items. Whether you're looking for stylish new outfits or trendy accessories, now is the perfect time to shop and save. Hurry, as stocks are limited and the sale ends in two weeks. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to update your wardrobe at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online today! Best regards, The Sales Team
